description: Source code for the DeliveryTrip doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for route processing, status updates, and related utility functions.

classes.name: DeliveryTrip
classes.description: Class representing a delivery trip, with methods for route calculation, status updates, and delivery note management.

methods.name: validate_stop_addresses
methods.description: Ensures each delivery stop has a customer address, fetching display address if missing.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the delivery trip based on stop visitation and document status.

methods.name: update_delivery_notes
methods.description: Updates connected delivery notes with trip details or clears them if delete=True.

methods.name: process_route
methods.description: Estimates arrival times for each stop, optionally optimizing the route.

methods.name: form_route_list
methods.description: Creates a list of route segments based on delivery stops, considering locks and optimization.

methods.name: rearrange_stops
methods.description: Reorders delivery stops based on an optimized route order.

methods.name: get_directions
methods.description: Retrieves map directions for a route, with optional waypoint optimization.
